summary: Lumi is now clearly yellow in my own live screenshots at 11:43 and at 17:30, and pumpkin bowling looks like a real, fun physics event in the film. The yellow is a very saturated lemon, and the pumpkin event itself was not watched live by me.
surprise_why: A simulated pumpkin stack that tumbles differently each time, with bonks, is a real step beyond scripted events.

findings.what: Live Lumi is a flat, very saturated lemon yellow (about 0.9, 0.9, 0.1) in the raster at midday, with little feather shading. The traced films show a warmer golden bird. The todo asked for the same yellow everywhere, and the two are not quite the same bird. At 17:30 the yellow holds up and reads well.
findings.evidence: world/reviews/s83-now.png (11:43) and world/reviews/s83-dusk.png (17:30, sandbox, dusk rain); both show Lumi yellow, and the first looks neon next to the muted trees
findings.suggestion: Lower the green gain a little so it lands near the traced gold. Keep the shading, and update STYLE.md.
findings.agent_notes: s84: the green gain came down from 1.52 to 1.4 (GAIN (1.2, 1.4, 1.3)): a warmer gold, still R .77 / G .63 at 11:00 (media/s84/lumi-golden.png).

findings.what: I did not see the pumpkin stack or the leaf pile run live: the sandbox was in a free camera, and the pumpkin film's second half is pumpkins at rest. The traced leaf still died with the GPU, so the leaf fix (todo #462) rests on the author's logs.
findings.suggestion: Trim the film's quiet tail and retry the traced leaf still after a worker restart.
